h: Calls reportedly grow for Atiku to drop his 2027 presidential ambition
p: Atiku Abubakar, the ADC's 2027 presidential candidate, is reportedly facing fresh calls to withdraw from the race. The report says a new reason has emerged behind the demand, though the details are still being discussed.
more: The call comes as parties step up their 2027 campaigns
Atiku earlier criticised President Tinubu over his remarks on hunger
